Genius Competitions

Source: R/genius.R
genius_competitions.Rd

Every competition of an org from the hosted WebStats chooser, with its END-year season.

Endpoint: GET https://hosted.dcd.shared.geniussports.com/{org}/en/schedule

One row per competition-season. year is the Genius year (START year for a two-year org, the year itself for a calendar org) and season the sdv END year: a two-year span in the label wins (2019 - 20 is 2020), else the Genius year plus one for a split org, else the year itself; season_rule names the rule (NA season when none applies). selected marks the competition the chooser pre-selects.

Usage

genius_competitions(org, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

org

Genius ORG code of the league (ESAKE, CEBL, BNXT, SLB, ...); see genius_competitions().

return_parsed

Parse into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the parsed body or page record (a list): data.json as served plus _request (the ids asked for), or the sdv-internal-refs capture shape of a page.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (a zero-row tibble with these columns when Genius answers an empty valid page), or the raw list when return_parsed = FALSE:

col_nametypedescription
orgcharacterORG code the request used (the hosted ORG, or the LiveStats ORG for the /u/ shell).
comp_idintegerGenius competition id (compId): one per org competition-season; the {compId} of hosted and data/competition paths
labelcharacterCompetition label as the org typed it, free text in any language: may or may not carry a season ('BASKET LEAGUE 2019 - 20', '1st division', 'Kypello Elladas' (in Greek script) = Greek Cup, 'Mavroskoufeia' (in Greek script) = Mavroskoufeia youth tournament)
league_idintegerGenius league id of the org (ESAKE = 115; IBBA has two: 187 and 549)
yearintegerGenius season year of the competition: the START year of a two-year season (BNXT '2023-2024' = 2023), the year itself for a calendar season. null when the page gives none
seasonintegersdv END-year season of the competition (2026 = 2025-26) from the label span, else the Genius year; null when no rule applies. See season_rule.
season_rulecharacterWhich rule produced season: 'label span', 'genius year + 1 (split)', 'genius year (calendar)', 'label year (calendar)' or 'unknown'.
selectedlogicalTrue for the competition the hosted chooser pre-selects (the org's default, not always the newest).

Details

Access. The Genius hosts publish no robots.txt and no terms. CloudFront refuses datacenter IPs on the LiveStats and hosted hosts: from a server set options(hoopR.proxy = ...) or the GENIUS_PROXY environment variable to an http(s) proxy URL (never printed or logged). Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host; keep crawls slow and incremental. Some league sites (the NZ NBL) forbid AI crawlers in their own robots.txt, which does not cover these hosts. Unofficial use of a public source: payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

Org and season. Every competition is an ORG code plus a competition id (comp_id): genius_competitions() lists an org's competitions with the sdv END-year season (a START-year org lists 2025-26 as season 2026), genius_match_competition() maps a game to its competition, and data.json itself names no date, competition or season. The hosted ORG can differ from the LiveStats ORG of /u/ (NZNBL vs NZN). Match ids are one global sequence across every Genius customer. data.json carries no global team or player id: tno (1 or 2) and pno are in-game numbers; only finished games are read.

Errors (classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data when Genius has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, the S3 AccessDenied 403, an empty 200 from the hosted host, an empty recent-games window, a schedule or widget with no matches); hoopR_bad_request for HTTP 400 / 422 or a URL that is not a Genius route (e.g. a non-numeric id); hoopR_asset_fetch when the answer is unknown: the CloudFront "Request blocked" 403, a rate limit or 5xx, the intermittent HTTP 500 "A website error has occurred" page (transient = TRUE: retry later), a dead connection, an error envelope, a cut-off page, an unfinished game, or a body for another match, competition or ORG.

See also

Other Genius Functions: bal_competition, esake_competition, genius_competition_games(), genius_game(), genius_game_crosswalk(), genius_match_competition(), genius_pbp(), genius_player_box(), genius_schedule(), genius_schedule_embed(), genius_shots(), genius_team_box(), genius_team_crosswalk(), genius_widget_games(), lnbm_competition, lub_competition, nznbl_competition, slb_competition
